children.name: The primary interactive element for triggering actions. Available in 3 variants, 4 tones, and 4 sizes.
Base layer containing all 48 visual combinations (3 Variants × 4 Tones × 4 Sizes). Controls appearance: fills, borders, icons, label, padding, and radius.
Internal component — do not use in layouts. Use Button instead.
Wrapper that adds 5 interaction states (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focused, Disabled) on top of .Button-options. Inherits all visual properties from the base layer inside.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A dual-action button combining a primary action with a dropdown trigger. Available in 2 types (Primary, Secondary) and 4 sizes.
Base layer containing all 8 visual combinations (2 Types × 4 Sizes). Controls appearance: fills, borders, divider, icons, label, padding, and radius.
Internal component — do not use in layouts. Use Split Button instead.

Wrapper that adds 6 interaction states (Default, Main Hover, Icon Hover, Main Pressed, Icon Pressed, Disabled) on top of .Split-Button-Option. Inherits all visual properties from the base layer inside.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A compact button displaying only an icon. Available in 3 variants (Primary, Secondary, Ghost), 4 tones, and 4 sizes.
Base layer containing all 48 visual combinations (3 Variants × 4 Tones × 4 Sizes). Controls appearance: fills, borders, icon, padding, and radius.
Internal component — do not use in layouts. Use Icon Only Button instead.
Wrapper that adds 4 interaction states (Default, Hover, Pressed, Disabled) on top of .Icon-Only-Options. Inherits all visual properties from the base layer inside.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A floating action button for the primary action on mobile screens. Available in 3 sizes (S, M, XL) with an expandable menu.
Base layer containing all 12 visual combinations (3 Sizes × 4 States). Controls appearance: fill, icon, radius, and size.
Internal component — do not use in layouts. Use FAB instead.
Wrapper that adds the expandable menu with up to 3 labeled items on top of _FAB options. This is the component to use in layouts.
This is the component to use in layouts.
A text-only button styled as a link. Available in 4 tones and 4 interaction states. No background or border — just text and an optional icon.
17 variants: 4 States (Default, Focused, Hover, Pressed) × 4 Tones (Default, Danger, Warning, Success) + 1 Disabled. No wrapper — this is the component to use directly in layouts.
